main_topics.reason: The whole conversation is about why fasting readings stay at 160-180 and what to do about them.
The user asked what they can do themselves and described their post-dinner walks and reduced rice over several turns.
Several turns covered when the user takes metformin, the dose, and whether the tablet is extended-release.
The bot suggested a 3am reading and the user questioned having to wake up to do it.
The bot raised insulin and other agents as options, but the user rejected insulin and wanted self-help steps instead.
The user pushed back on being sent to the doctor, saying they wanted things they can do themselves.

output.summary: The user asked why their fasting sugar is always high (160-180) while daytime readings are fine, and said they take only metformin 1000mg at night. The bot first assumed insulin and brought it up again after the user said they do not take it, then repeated its light-dinner advice after the user had said they already do that. It ended with a plan to do a 3am check and see the doctor, and the user said they understood and thanked it.
